item.title: The Race to Lead San Diego County’s Second Largest City Just Got a Lot More Interesting
item.description: Chula Vista Elementary School District Trustee Francisco Tamayo announced this week he is running to unseat Chula Vista Mayor John McCann. The move represents an effort by Democrats to reclaim mayoral power in a key South County city. The post The Race to Lead San Diego County’s Second Largest City Just Got a Lot More Interesting appeared first on Voice of San Diego.
